name: Alan Escobar
title: IT Support Specialist
summary: Tier 1 IT support technician at a managed service provider (MSP), handling up to 50 tickets a day across about 100 client organizations, from individual users to small businesses. Hands-on with Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, ConnectWise Automate/Manage, and SimpleMDM, including Windows 11 upgrades, MFA rollouts, and workstation cloning and profile migration. First responder on a live security incident, backed by CompTIA Security+ and ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity, with CompTIA A+ in progress. Brings 10+ years of detail-driven finance, public-service, and customer-facing work: clear documentation, calm communication, and training others.
